title: Establish stability thresholds and auto-pin policy for HW perf profiles
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Define deterministic stability thresholds and a conservative auto-pin decision policy for hardware-specific performance profiles (A100, H100, L40S, MI300). Goal: let the onboarding pipeline publish and optionally auto-pin model->hw variants when a run meets unit economics and stability criteria, while minimizing false-positive pins and production regression risk. Deliverables: 1) a formal stability metric and scoring function computed from daily benchmark windows (latency percentiles, token throughput, failure rate, kv-cache correctness), 2) numeric thresholds per device family and workload class, 3) an auto-pin algorithm that produces recommendations and an opt-in automated pinning job with rollback guardrails, 4) publishing pipeline changes (manifest signature, provenance metadata, S3 layout, and audit log entries), and 5) canary rollout playbook and dashboards to monitor pinned variants. This ticket covers policy, threshold calibration, evaluation harness integration, and initial automation; separate follow-ups will implement broader UI/console controls and enterprise approval flows.
comments: 2026-02-10 - Initial proposal: collated requirements from Onboarding, Runtime, and QA. Proposed stability score = 1 - (outlier_rate * 0.6 + failure_rate * 0.4) normalized over a 24h rolling window. Recommend min_samples = 2k tokens per config to consider auto-pin.

2026-02-17 - Bench results attached: A100 throughput median across tests = 7.8k tokens/s, p95 latency 280ms; H100 median = 11.9k tokens/s, p95 = 180ms; L40S median = 14.6k tokens/s, p95 = 160ms; MI300 median = 10.5k tokens/s, p95 = 220ms. Variance between runs for some long-context workloads observed (~12-18%).

2026-02-22 - Design review notes: PM (Leah Chen) asks to make thresholds workload-class aware (chat vs completion vs embedding). Agreed to separate thresholds for short-chat (<512 tokens), long-context generation (>=1024 tokens), and embedding batches.

2026-03-02 - Engineering feedback: implement conservative auto-pin rule: require stability_score >= 0.985, p95 within 10% of baseline pinned variant, no more than 0.5% failure rate, and at least 48h of continuous successful benchmarks crossing min_samples per day. If auto-pin triggers, create draft model manifest and open a PR to model-catalog repo; automatic merge only if 2 approvers or a certifier tag present.

2026-03-05 - QA report: ran canary for long-context generation on H100 vs current pinned H100 variant across 20k calls; observed 0.12% increase in hallucination regression signal on one prompt set — flagged as medium risk. Recommendation: hold auto-pin for that workload class until eval set updated and re-run.

2026-03-09 - Security/Compliance input: audit log and KMS signing for published manifests required. Added requirement to store signed manifest and performance signature in s3://redwood-profile-artifacts/{model}/{version}/{hw}/signed-manifest.json.
